title: Open the CrewDesk link your Line Producer sent you
Enter the production code and your mobile number
You’re in. This page shows what’s left to do
Fill your details exactly as on your PAN card and bank account
Upload photos of your Aadhaar and PAN card
Read your agreement, type your name and sign with your finger
To get paid, raise an invoice in My invoices
The bell tells you when it’s checked, approved and paid
